shortDescription: Manage dldp authentication,interface,timeout and mode  on Comware 7 devices.

options.name: auth_mode
options.description: Configure dldp authentication mode between current device and neighbor device.

options.name: init_delay
options.description: Delay time of dldp blocking interface from initial state to single pass state.(1~5)

options.name: interface_enable
options.description: Enable dldp function on the interface.

options.name: name
options.description: The full name of the interface.

options.name: port_shutdown
options.description: The interface shutdown mode after dldp discovers one-way link is configured on the interface.

options.name: pwd
options.description: Configure the dldp authentication password between the current device and the neighbor device

options.name: pwd_mode
options.description: Configure the dldp authentication password mode between the current device and the neighbor device.

options.name: shutdown_mode
options.description: Global configuration of interface shutdown mode after dldp discovers unidirectional link.

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state for the interface configuration.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Configure the sending interval of advertisement message(1~100)
